results.title: Placeholder
results.overview: As a service provider, Heikki's mission is to deliver relationship experiences to his clients, with no strings attached. Because of the dysfunctional nature of his own life, he wants to make the experiences as realistic as he can - in other words, as unpleasant as possible.

results.title: A Table For Two
results.overview: Their separate worlds converge when a restaurant owner suggests they "share a table" during overlapping lunch breaks. What starts as awkward silence evolves into tacit understanding over shared noodles, leading them to explore Shanghai's culinary scene together .

results.title: A Season of Promises
results.overview: Heidi and Sophie are sisters who couldn't be more different – Heidi is buttoned-up and laser-focused on landing the play-by-play job for the local pro hockey team while Sophie is following her dream of making it in stand-up comedy while waitressing. Though a years-ago rift following their mother's passing has pulled the sisters apart, what they do share is a deep love for their father, Ed. When a fainting episode lands Ed in the hospital, Heidi and Sophie rush to his side. Hating seeing their father in that state – and still alone four years after losing their mother – the sisters decide to set aside their differences and team up to play Cupid at Christmas. As Heidi and Sophie work together to prepare Ed for the dating world in the hope he'll find someone special in time for the holiday, they each go on their own journeys that bring them unexpected joy, love and peace for Christmas.

results.title: Supernatural Academy: Birth of the Dragon Marked
results.original_title: Supernatural Academy: Birth of the Dragon Marked
results.overview: Privileged wolf shifter Jessa LeBron discovers she has a forbidden twin sister, Mischa, and that both carry the dangerous "Dragon Mark". As they reunite at the Supernatural Academy and uncover dark school secrets, they must figure out how to survive a world that fears them and prevent the revival of the Dragon King.

results.title: Anhedonia
results.overview: Two teenagers meet one last time before one of them returns to the countryside she so deeply despises. She takes solace in the promise that her lover will soon come to visit her there. Trapped in darkness, she can do nothing but wait. Time passes—and even after death, her tormented spirit lingers earthbound, longing for the moment the two may finally be together again.

results.title: CHAT
results.overview: A family's fresh start unravels when their son discovers an AI powered tablet, unleashing a wave of terror tied not only to the supernatural but to dark secrets of greed and corruption that surround them.

results.title: KPOP Smoothie
results.overview: A broke Korean American student walks into a KPOP themed smoothie store and unknowingly orders a overpriced smoothie.

results.title: Onwards and Sideways
results.overview: Tony Evans is the deputy head of a local primary school. Emma Dretzin is a pianist, composer and single mother of two daughters. Neither knows the other until a startling encounter changes the course of their lives: on the same morning, they are both confronted with a diagnosis of Parkinson’s.

results.title: Under the blazing sun
results.overview: Her marriage might be over, and her acting career might be fading away, but her desire is as scorching as ever.

results.title: Doppelgänger
results.overview: When ten-year old Josie Johns met her doppelgänger, it kicked off a decade of intense and bitter rivalry. Now an adult, Josie is about to confront her double, settle some scores, and take back control of her identity once and for all.

results.title: Henry's First Dates
results.original_title: จีบซ้ำซ้ำ เฮนรี่จำไม่ได้
results.overview: Lucy, a woman who's living her first date on repeat with Henry, a good-natured, animal-loving guy with a bizarre condition: every time he wakes up, he can't remember anything from the day before.

results.title: Original Night
results.overview: Told in two semi-fictional acts, this 16mm film serves as an elegy for Europe’s last wallabies — a marsupial animal from Australia, introduced in Scotland in the 1940s. Reflecting on humanity’s enduring urge to record animals, from prehistoric cave art to early cinema, Alasdair Asmussen Doyle links the extinction of species with the evolution of image-making.

results.title: Implant
results.overview: An ambitious neurosurgeon creates a brain implant that lets him control patients, but his breakthrough turns abusive. As one victim unravels under forced commands, a colleague races to stop the experiment before it becomes deadly.

results.title: Diabolical: The Epstein Files
results.overview: It's the scandal that has shocked Americans and rocked the Trump administration. A legal and political saga that has shattered fundamental beliefs that all are equal in the eyes of the law. What do the Epstein Files reveal?

results.title: Spa
results.overview: The narrative follows the intertwined lives of people connected to La Paradise, an urban massage therapy centre. It centres on Mathan, a man struggling to distinguish between the reality of love and its fictionalised ideals. Through a sharp lens of social satire, the story explores adult themes and human behaviour within this unique urban setting.

results.title: Surplace
results.overview: On prom night, graduate Inga discovers that her boyfriend Kęstas is secretly helping a young stranger. As the night unfolds, the youth begins to sense that while they’re celebrating new beginnings, someone is searching for their own path into the future.

results.title: Nice Women
results.overview: Milena takes care of two children, a grandmother, and a pregnant sister while her husband is in rehab. When overwhelmed, she drives to the airport to watch travelers. One day, she meets a man there who mistakes her for his driver. Milena plays along, bonds with the stranger, and starts an affair.

results.title: Rogue Trooper
results.overview: Rogue is a "Genetic Infantryman", a genetically-engineered, blue-skinned, manufactured super soldier who, alongside his three comrades, is searching for the Traitor General. His comrades are with him in the form of biochips—onto which a G.I.'s entire personality is downloaded at the time of death for later retrieval—and are named Gunnar (mounted on Rogue's rifle), Bagman (on his backpack) and Helm (on his helmet). Rogue is designed to be immune to almost all known toxins, can submerge in strong acid unaffected, and is able to withstand a vacuum on his bare skin.

results.title: A Familiar Pain
results.overview: Some politicians argue that buying a gun should be as simple as getting a driver’s license. But will having more guns actually protect your family? Flávio Bolsonaro and his allies want to make it even easier to access firearms in Brazil. When the Jair Bolsonaro administration relaxed gun regulations, legally purchased weapons ended up in the hands of organized crime, while women and children became even more exposed to violence. In the final episode of the season, Alessandra Orofino, general director of *Revelando*, reveals how the Bolsonaros’ gun policy has put even more Brazilian lives at risk.
